info.title: Actae Instance API (actae.api.v1)
info.description: Generated from spec/api-parity/v1/manifest.json — the source of truth for all 75 canonical operations.  Do not edit by hand.

post.summary: Exchange an API key for a dashboard session JWT.

get.summary: Discover instance API version, capabilities, limits, operation manifest reference, and the caller's principal grants.
Public auth configuration (e.g. whether signup is enabled).

post.summary: Password login. Opt-in via ENABLE_SIGNUP (403 otherwise).
Log out (client-side session invalidation; stateless server response).

get.summary: Return the authenticated principal profile.

post.summary: Create a password account. Opt-in via ENABLE_SIGNUP (403 otherwise).

get.summary: List active channels with per-channel stats.
Compare two channels: combined what-changed doc (state/config/tools/output/metrics).
Structural state diff between two channels' latest saved states.

post.summary: Fork a channel at a cursor into a new child channel. Returns the exact child_channel_id + immutable ForkReceipt. Fork is storage, not execution.

delete.summary: Delete a channel. Fails 410 when already deleted, 409 when it has children.

post.summary: Close a channel lifecycle (stamps closed_at on the registry).

get.summary: Get the recursive execution tree rooted at a channel.
List direct child forks of a channel.
Get channel metadata (fork boundary, manifest, provenance).

put.summary: Update channel metadata (display name, reason, experiment metadata).

patch.summary: Record a fork outcome for ranking.

post.summary: Promote a child channel into its parent (experiment promotion).

get.summary: Get the immutable fork receipt for a channel (provenance record).
Highest step number recorded on a channel (0 = none); O(1) crash-recovery probe.
Resolve a server-owned step index entry (step -> event/cursor).
Get the decision trail: lineage chain + boundary state + tool-execution ledger.
Get the latest per-channel cursor for resume.

post.summary: Query events across channels with filters and optional opaque keyset page_token (additive).
Record a single event on a channel. Idempotent when operation_id is supplied.

get.summary: Replay events from a channel, optionally from a per-channel cursor.

post.summary: Atomic event + state transition with optimistic version guard.

get.summary: Verify the tamper-evident hash chain for a channel.
Get the causal dependency graph rooted at an event.

post.summary: Create a fork group for counterfactual execution across an execution group.

get.summary: Get an execution group fork.

post.summary: Promote an execution group fork member (counterfactual adoption).
Acknowledge an execution group message.
Create an execution group for coordinated parallel agents.

get.summary: List execution groups.

post.summary: Add a member to an execution group.

get.summary: List execution group members.

post.summary: Claim an execution group member (fenced lease).
Heartbeat an execution group member lease.

get.summary: List messages addressed to an execution group member.

post.summary: Release an execution group member (end lease).
Send a message within an execution group.

get.summary: List tool executions.

post.summary: Claim an idempotent tool execution.

get.summary: Get one tool execution.

post.summary: Cancel a claimed tool execution.
Complete a tool execution with its result.
Fail a tool execution with error details.
Heartbeat a claimed tool execution.
Create an experiment group.

get.summary: List experiment groups.
Get one experiment group with members.

post.summary: Add a fork to an experiment group.

get.summary: Rank experiment members by score.

post.summary: Create a durable consumer group.

get.summary: List consumer groups.

post.summary: Acknowledge completed work; advances the consumer's offset.
Heartbeat a consumer lease.
Join a consumer group as a worker.

get.summary: Get per-consumer offsets for a group.

post.summary: Claim a work item from a consumer group (lease).

get.summary: Return this instance's immutable identity (installation id, version, mode, feature/capability metadata) for federation and diagnostics.

post.summary: Create a persisted wake-up.

get.summary: List wake-ups.
Get one wake-up.

post.summary: Save a cursor-aligned immutable state snapshot for a channel.

get.summary: Load the latest state snapshot for a channel (resume).
Load a specific state version.

delete.summary: Delete a specific state version (destructive; requires write permission).

get.summary: List state version history for a channel.
Get the caller's opaque preferences JSON (<=64 KB).

put.summary: Upsert the caller's opaque preferences JSON (whole-object replace, <=64 KB).
